svg.title: Loadout: Yunus's toolkit as an RPG inventory
svg.desc: A pixel-art inventory screen with three tabs. Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, C#, Swift. Build: Node.js, Next.js, Unity, tree-sitter, MCP, GitHub Actions. Cloud and AI: AWS, Azure, Claude, Ollama, Whisper. A cursor steps from slot to slot and an item info window shows where each tool is used, for example Python in dwago and capture-check, Go in a urfave/cli PR, and Claude as build partner. The red-hooded hero from Yunus's game follows the cursor along the tabs and raises each selected item over his head.
